comment: Interpolator list for scripts/distillation_contract.py. Each operator is qbar Gamma q with gamma in {id, g5, gt, gx} or products (g5gt, ...), spatial 'smeared' (Laplacian-eigenvector smearing with momentum phase) or 'deriv' (symmetric covariant derivative), and an integer momentum index p_n = 2 pi n / Nx. Operators inside one channel are contracted into a correlator matrix and solved as a GEVP; keep operators with matching quantum numbers together.
